BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain floor-tile)
  (:requirements :typing :action-costs)
  (:types 
    robot tile color - object
  )
  (:predicates 
    (robot-at ?r - robot ?x - tile)
    (up ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    (down ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    (right ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    (left ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    (clear ?x - tile)
    (painted ?x - tile ?c - color)
    (robot-has ?r - robot ?c - color)
    (available-color ?c - color)
  )
  (:functions 
    (total-cost)
  )

  (:action change-color
    :parameters (?r - robot ?c - color ?c2 - color)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-has ?r ?c) 
      (available-color ?c2)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (robot-has ?r ?c)) 
      (robot-has ?r ?c2) 
      (increase (total-cost) 5)
    )
  )

  (:action paint-up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?y - tile ?x - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-has ?r ?c) 
      (robot-at ?r ?y) 
      (up ?y ?x) 
      (clear ?x)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (clear ?x)) 
      (painted ?x ?c) 
      (increase (total-cost) 2)
    )
  )

  (:action paint-down
    :parameters (?r - robot ?y - tile ?x - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-has ?r ?c) 
      (robot-at ?r ?y) 
      (down ?y ?x) 
      (clear ?x)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (clear ?x)) 
      (painted ?x ?c) 
      (increase (total-cost) 2)
    )
  )

  (:action up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-at ?r ?x) 
      (up ?x ?y) 
      (clear ?y)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (robot-at ?r ?x)) 
      (robot-at ?r ?y) 
      (not (clear ?y)) 
      (clear ?x) 
      (increase (total-cost) 3)
    )
  )

  (:action down
    :parameters (?r - robot ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-at ?r ?x) 
      (down ?x ?y) 
      (clear ?y)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (robot-at ?r ?x)) 
      (robot-at ?r ?y) 
      (not (clear ?y)) 
      (clear ?x) 
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  (:action right
    :parameters (?r - robot ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-at ?r ?x) 
      (right ?y ?x) 
      (clear ?y)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (robot-at ?r ?x)) 
      (robot-at ?r ?y) 
      (not (clear ?y)) 
      (clear ?x) 
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  (:action left
    :parameters (?r - robot ?x - tile ?y - tile)
    :precondition (and 
      (robot-at ?r ?x) 
      (left ?y ?x) 
      (clear ?y)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (robot-at ?r ?x)) 
      (robot-at ?r ?y) 
      (not (clear ?y)) 
      (clear ?x) 
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )
)
END DOMAIN
